y-m-25-08.title: Siyaze sithembe isibalo u-y=−5x+200 kuze kube nini?
y-m-25-08.topic: Ububanzi lapho imodeli yomsebenzi womugqa isebenza khona: uma isimo sishintsha, isibalo naso siyashintsha
y-m-25-08.goal: Hlola ububanzi nezimo lapho isibalo somsebenzi womugqa sisebenza khona, futhi uqonde ukuthi isibalo singashintsha uma isimo sishintsha, ubuyekeza isahlulelo sakho ngolwazi olusha.
y-m-25-08.material: Uma uvula i-valve yokukhipha ethangini elibamba u-200 L wamanzi, amanzi aphuma ngo-5 L ngomzuzu. Biza umzuzu lapho i-valve ivulwa ngo-0 imizuzu, futhi ake inani lamanzi asele ethangini ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-x libe ngu-y L. Bheka u-0 imizuzu kuya ku-60 imizuzu. Amanzi asethangini awakwazi ukwehla ngaphansi kuka-0 L.

y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kusele amanzi amangaki ethangini ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-30?
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.after: y = −5×30 + 200 = 50 L. Lilinani elingaphakathi kobubanzi lapho isibalo sisebenza khona (0 ≤ x ≤ 40).
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ufake isikhathi esibalweni futhi wathola inani elisele.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Awubonanga ukuthi inani lingatholakala noma isibalo sinikeziwe.

y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Isibalo singabalwa, kodwa esimweni amanzi awakwazi ukuba ngaphansi kuka-0 L. Ibanga lapho isibalo singathenjwa khona ngu-0 ≤ x ≤ 40.

y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isibalo sihambisana nesimo kuze kube yimizuzu engu-40 kuphela, futhi ngemva kwalokho amanzi asele angu-0 L

y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Ngemizuzu engu-20 kusele u-100 L, futhi kuhlala kunjalo kuze kube yimizuzu engu-25. Kusukela emizuzwini engu-25 liyahliza ngo-5 L ngesikhathi, ngakho ngemizuzu engu-30 kungu-100 − 25 = 75 L.

y-m-25-08.s.s2.prompt: Ivalvu yavalwa ngemizuzu engu-20 yavulwa futhi ngemizuzu engu-25 (isivinini sokuhliza siyafana). Faka izikhathi ezi-3 ezihlukile x imizuzu lapho inani langempela lamanzi asele lihlukile kunenani lesibalo y = −5x + 200, kanye namanzi asele y L ngaleso sikhathi, njengo-(x, y). Kodwa, 20 < x ≤ 60.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amanzi asele ngemizuzu engu-20, imizuzu engu-25, nemizuzu engu-30 ngokulandelana.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ngokwehlukana kuphela isikhathi amanzi ahliza ngaso ngempela.

y-m-25-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Liyinani langempela lamanzi asele ngaleso sikhathi.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Akulona inani langempela lamanzi asele ngaleso sikhathi. Hlukanisa isikhathi sibe ngesikhathi ivalvu ivuliwe nesikhathi ivaliwe.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.explain: Kusukela emizuzwini engu-20 kuya ku-25 kuhlala ku-100 L. Kusukela emizuzwini engu-25 kungu-y = 100 − 5(x − 25) = 225 − 5x, futhi uma kuphela ngemizuzu engu-45, ngemva kwalokho kungu-0 L. Ngemva kwemizuzu engu-20, amanani ahluka kusibalo sokuqala.

y-m-25-07.title: U-a no-b kumele babe yizinombolo muni ukuze umugqa ungadluli ku-quadrant yesibili?
y-m-25-07.topic: Ama-quadrant idlula kuwo igrafu yomsebenzi womugqa, nezimpawu zokuthambeka nokunqamula kuka-y
y-m-25-07.goal: Thola isimo sokuthi umugqa ungadluli ku-quadrant yesibili usebenzisa izimpawu zokuthambeka nokunqamula kuka-y, ngaphandle kokuphutha umkhawulo (icala lapho ukunqamula kuka-y kungu-0).
y-m-25-07.material: Igrafu yomsebenzi womugqa u-y=ax+b iyimugqa (u-a uyinombolo engesiyo u-0). U-a ngukuthambeka futhi u-b ukunqamula kuka-y. I-quadrant yesibili iyindawo yamaphoyinti anokuxhumanisa kuka-x okunegethivu nokuxhumanisa kuka-y okuphozithivu. Amaphoyinti ku-x-axis noma y-axis awekho kunoma iyiphi i-quadrant.
y-m-25-07.prereq.0: Incazelo yokuthambeka nokunqamula kuka-y emsebenzini womugqa u-y=ax+b
y-m-25-07.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwemigqa elandelayo, khetha yonke engadluli ku-quadrant yesibili.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kusibalo ngasinye, bala ukuthi u-y uyini uma u-x engu--1 no--10.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.hint.1: Funa indawo lapho u-y eba iphozithivu uma u-x enegethivu.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.a: Ukhumbule isimo somugqa onokuthambeka okuphozithivu nokunqamula kuka-y okunegethivu.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi uma ukunqamula kuka-y kunegethivu, umugqa oya phezulu ngakwesobunxele nawo ugwema i-quadrant yesibili.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.c: Waphuthelwa ukuthi uma ukunqamula kuka-y kuphozithivu, noma uya ngakwesobunxele, ukhona ingxenye ephezulu.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi umugqa odlula endaweni yokuqala awudluli kunoma iyiphi i-quadrant.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.e: Uyazi ukuthi noma umugqa odlula endaweni yokuqala udlula kuphela ipheya elilodwa lama-quadrant.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.explain: I-quadrant yesibili iyindawo x < 0, y > 0. Ku-y = 3x − 2 no-y = 2x, u-y unegethivu (noma u-0) uma u-x enegethivu, ngakho abangeni kule ndawo. Kwabanye, u-y uba iphozithivu kwenye indawo lapho u-x enegethivu.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ama-(a, b) angu-3 ahlukile emisebenzini yomugqa u-y = ax + b engadluli ku-quadrant yesibili. U-a ngukuthambeka futhi u-b ukunqamula kuka-y.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza ukuthambeka kube iphozithivu, shintsha ukunqamula kuka-y, futhi uhlole ukuthi u-y uba iphozithivu ku-x = −1 no--10.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola icala lapho ukunqamula kuka-y kungu-0 nelicala lapho kunegethivu ngokuhlukile.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Ngalokhu kuthambeka, u-y uba iphozithivu kwenye indawo lapho u-x encane ngokwanele, noma akulona umsebenzi womugqa. Hlola futhi uphawu lokuthambeka.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukunqamula kuka-y kukhulu, ngakho noma kancane ngakwesobunxele ngenhla kwe-y-axis, u-y uphozithivu. Hlola futhi ububanzi bokunqamula kuka-y.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo: (3, −2), (2, 0), (0.5, −4). Uma ukuthambeka kuphozithivu futhi ukunqamula kuka-y kungu-0 noma kungaphansi, umugqa udlula kuphela ku-quadrant yokuqala neyesithathu (nakwi-quadrant yesine uma ukunqamula kuka-y kunegethivu).
y-m-25-07.s.s3.prompt: Umfundi wafingqa imiphumela engenhla ngezizathu. Khetha umugqa ophosile (izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1 njengoba zivela esikrinini).
y-m-25-07.s.s3.hint.0: Hlola umugqa onou-b = 0 (isibonelo, y = 2x) endaweni lapho u-x enegethivu.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funa isibonelo phakathi kwalokho owakwenza esinyathelweni 2 esingavumelani nalesi sifinyezo.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.0: Uma u-a < 0, u-y uba iphozithivu kwenye indawo lapho u-x encane ngokwanele, ngakho umugqa udlula ku-quadrant yesibili. Ngakho u-a kumele abe > 0.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.1: Uma u-a > 0 no-b > 0, bese ukuhamba kancane ngakwesobunxele kusuka ephoyintini (0, b), u-y uphozithivu, ngakho udlula ku-quadrant yesibili.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.2: Uma u-b = 0 udlula endaweni yokuqala, kodwa kulokhu akukho kunqamula kuka-y, ngakho u-b < 0 kuphela kuyenzeka.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.3: Isifinyezo: akudluli ku-quadrant yesibili kuphela uma u-a > 0 no-b < 0.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.explain: Yimigqa 3 no-4. Umugqa odlula endaweni yokuqala nawo unokunqamula kuka-y, okungu-0 (b = 0). Uma u-a > 0 no-b = 0, lo mugqa awudluli ku-quadrant yesibili. Ngakho isifinyezo ngu-a > 0 no-b ≤ 0.

y-m-25-03.title: Isibalo esidlula kuwo womabili amaphoyinti: singasethemba yini?
y-m-25-03.topic: Isibalo selayini elidlula emaphoyinteni amabili: ukuzimela kokuhlola, namaphutha esixazululweni
y-m-25-03.goal: Hlola ukuthi ukuhlola kuzimele yini kulwazi olusetshenzisiwe ukwenza isibalo, uthole umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni, bese wenza amaphoyinti esibalweni esilungisiwe.
y-m-25-03.material: UMinsu uzame ukubhala ilayini elidlula emaphoyinteni amabili A(2, 3) no-B(6, 11) endizeni yokuqondanisa njengesibalo sohlobo y=ax+b. Isibalo uMinsu asithole singu-y=(1/2)x+2. UMinsu uthi uqedile ukuhlola ngokuthi 'ngifake iphoyinti A(2, 3), (1/2)×2+2=3, ngakho kulungile'.
y-m-25-03.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-slope a emsebenzini olayini y=ax+b
y-m-25-03.prereq.1: Indlela yokuhlola ngokufaka ukuqondanisa kwephoyinti esibalweni ukubona ukuthi sigcina yini
y-m-25-03.s.s1.prompt: Isibalo uMinsu asithole singu-y=(1/2)x+2 (kufundwa: y alingana nengxenye ka-x kanye no-2), futhi uthi sasebenza uma efaka iphoyinti A(2, 3). Ungaqiniseka ukuthi isibalo silungile ngalokhu kuphela? Khetha isahlulelo esifanele kakhulu.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.hint.0: Khumbula ukuthi uMinsu cishe wasebenzisa liphi lamaphoyinti A no-B, nokuthi kanjani, lapho enza isibalo.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ukuhlola kunencazelo kuphela uma kwenziwa ngolwazi olungasetshenzisiwe ukwenza isibalo.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.o.a: Kusebenze ku-A, ngakho ungaqiniseka ukuthi isibalo silungile futhi akudingeki ukuhlola kakhulu
y-m-25-03.s.s1.r.a: Awucabangi ukuthi iphoyinti elisetshenziswe ukuhlola liyahambisana yini nolwazi olusetshenziselwe ukwenza isibalo.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.o.b: U-A uyiphoyinti elisetshenziselwe ukwenza isibalo, ngakho kufanele ufake futhi no-B(6, 11)
y-m-25-03.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi ukuhlola kunencazelo kuphela uma kwenziwa ngolwazi olungasetshenzisiwe ukwenza isibalo.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.o.c: Kusebenze ku-A, kodwa kumele ukuthi akulungile ku-B, ngakho isibalo kumele silahlwe
y-m-25-03.s.s1.explain: Kungaba yinto yemvelo ukuthi isebenze endaweni esetshenziselwe ukwenza isibalo. Ungazi ukuthi isibalo sidlula kuwo womabili amaphoyinti kuphela ngokuhlola ngephoyinti elingakasetshenziswa (noma ngenye indlela).
y-m-25-03.s.s2.prompt: Lapho kufakwa u-B(6, 11), isibalo sikaMinsu savela singalungile. Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaMinsu (izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1 njengoba zivela esikrinini).
y-m-25-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ngaphambi kokuphinda ukubala komugqa ngamunye, sebenza emuva kusukela eqinisweni lokuthi ukufaka u-B kukhombisa ukuthi akulungile.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zithole wena inani x elikhula ngalo nenani y elikhula ngalo phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili, bese uqhathanisa nomugqa 2.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.0: Vumela isibalo selayini elidlula ku-A(2, 3) no-B(6, 11) sibe y = ax + b.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.2: Ukufaka u-A(2, 3) ku-y = (1/2)x + b kunika u-3 = 1 + b, ngakho b = 2
y-m-25-03.s.s2.explain: Ngumugqa 2. I-slope ngu-(ukwanda kuka-y) ÷ (ukwanda kuka-x), ngakho (11−3) ÷ (6−2) = 8/4 = 2. Imigqa 3 no-4 ziyiziphumo zokuqhubeka nge-slope engalungile. Isibalo esilungile singu-y = 2x − 1, futhi uma kufakwa u-B(6, 11), 12 − 1 = 11 iyagcina.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.prompt: Thola amaphoyinti ama-3 ahlukene alele esibalweni esilungile futhi angeyona u-A noma u-B, bese uwafaka njenge-(x, y). Kodwa, x ingu-−10 kuya ku-10.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.hint.0: Thola ukuthi y ikhula kangakanani uma x ikhula ngo-4 kusuka ku-A kuya ku-B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kusukela ku-A, thola amaphoyinti ngamunye usebenzisa ukuthi y ishintsha kangakanani njalo uma x ikhula ngo-1.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Leli phoyinti lilele kulayini odlula ku-A no-B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Leli phoyinti alilele kulayini odlula ku-A no-B. Qhathanisa isilinganiso sokukhula kuka-x nokukhula kuka-y kusuka ku-A kuya kuleli phoyinti naleso se-AB.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Liyiphoyinti elifanayo no-A noma no-B. Thola elihlukile.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo: (0, −1), (1, 1), (4, 7). Wonke angamaphoyinti ku-y = 2x − 1. Kunelayini elilodwa kuphela elidlula emaphoyinteni amabili, ngakho ngesibalo esilungile, noma yiluphi u-x unika iphoyinti kulayini ofanayo. Iphoyinti (4, 4) esibalweni sikaMinsu y = (1/2)x + 2 alikho kulesi sibalo.

y-m-25-04.title: Ngisho noma izibalo ezimbili zibukeka zihlukile, ingabe kukhona isixazululo esisodwa kuphela?
y-m-25-04.topic: Izixazululo zezibalo ezilayini ezihlangene nezindawo zamalayini amabili (isixazululo esisodwa, akukho, ezingapheliyo)
y-m-25-04.goal: Qonda ukuthi izibalo ezimbili ezilayini ezibukeka zihlukile zingaba yilayini ofanayo, hlela izimo lapho inani lezixazululo lincike ku-constant, bese wenza wena izibalo zelayini elifanayo.
y-m-25-04.material: Ezibalweni ezihlangene, isibalo selayini ax+by=c singadwetshwa njengelayini endizeni yokuqondanisa (a no-b akulona kokubili u-0). Uma amalayini amabili ehlangana endaweni eyodwa, kukhona ipheya elilodwa lezixazululo; uma engahlangani, akukho sixazululo; futhi uma ewela ngokuphelele, kunezixazululo ezingapheliyo. Ipheya (x, y) elihlangabezana nezibalo zombili libizwa ngokuthi isixazululo sezibalo ezihlangene.
y-m-25-04.prereq.0: Ukubona izixazululo zesibalo selayini ax+by=c njengamaphoyinti endizeni yokuqondanisa
y-m-25-04.s.s1.prompt: Mangaki amapheya (x, y) ahlangabezana nesibalo sokuqala 2x − y = −1 (kufundwa: 2x kususwa y kulingana nenegethivu 1) nesibalo sesibili 4x − 2y = −2?
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kabusha isibalo ngasinye ngendlela y = (slope)x + (y-intercept) bese ubabhala eceleni komunye.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x = 0 no-x = 1 kuzo zombili izibalo, thola amanani e-y, bese uqhathanisa.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.a: Kunepheya elilodwa kuphela. Ngoba izibalo ezimbili zinezimo ezihlukile
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi uma izibalo zibukeka zihlukile, ziyizilayini ezihlukile.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.b: Alikho ipheya. Ngoba amalayini amabili anayo i-slope efanayo, ngakho ayafana
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.b: Ubheke kuphela ukuthi ama-slope alingana futhi awuqhathanisanga ama-y-intercept.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.c: Zikhona ezingapheliyo. Ngoba izibalo ezimbili zimele ilayini elifanayo
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi ngisho noma ukubukeka kuhlukile, kungaba yilayini ofanayo.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.explain: Uma uhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ze-4x − 2y = −2 ngo-2, uthola u-2x − y = −1. Izibalo ezimbili ziyilayini ofanayo, ngakho wonke amaphoyinti kulayini ayizixazululo.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.prompt: Gcina isibalo sokuqala njengoba sinjalo, bese ushintsha isibalo sesibili sibe ngu-4x − 2y = c (c iyi-constant). Inani lezixazululo lishintsha kanjani kuye ngenani le-c?
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka izinombolo ezimbalwa (isibonelo, −2, 0, 4) esikhundleni se-c bese uqhathanisa ama-y-intercept amalayini amabili.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa izimo lapho amalayini amabili anayo i-slope efanayo zibe ezinama-y-intercept afanayo nalezo ezinama-y-intercept ahlukile.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.a: Noma c iyini, kunezixazululo ezingapheliyo. Ngoba ama-coefficient ayafana
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.a: Ubheke kuphela ama-coefficient esibalo futhi awucabangi nge-constant term c.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.b: Kunezixazululo ezingapheliyo kuphela ku-c oyedwa, futhi kwabasele akukho sixazululo
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.b: Ubone ukuthi uma c ishintsha, ilayini likhuphuka ngokufanayo.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.c: Akukho sixazululo kuphela ku-c oyedwa, futhi ku-c omunye kukhona ipheya elilodwa ngalinye
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi uma ama-slope elingana, amalayini ahlangana kuzo zonke izimo.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.d: Uma c engeyona u-0, njalo kukhona ipheya elilodwa, futhi uma ingu-0, akukho
y-m-25-04.s.s2.explain: 4x − 2y = c ngu-y = 2x − c/2, futhi isibalo sokuqala ngu-y = 2x + 1. Ama-slope ayafana, ngakho ayilayini efanayo kuphela uma c = −2, futhi kwamanye ama-c ayafana futhi awawelani, ngakho akukho sixazululo.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.prompt: Yenza isibalo sesibili ax + by = c esimele ilayini elifanayo nesibalo sokuqala 2x − y = −1. Ukuze ukubukeka kungafani, a akumele abe ngu-2, futhi faka izibalo ezi-3 ezihlukene njenge-(a, b, c).
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala phansi ama-coefficient 2, −1, −1 esibalo sokuqala bese uwabeka eceleni kuka-a, b, c wesibalo sesibili.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi izibalo ezimbili zidlula emaphoyinteni afanayo uma x = 0 nalapho y = 0 yini.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Isilinganiso sama-coefficient ka-x no-y siyafana nesesibalo sokuqala, ngakho i-slope iyafana.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Isilinganiso sama-coefficient ka-x no-y sihlukile kunesesibalo sokuqala, ngakho i-slope ihlukile.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c2: I-constant term nayo isesilinganisweni esifanayo, ngakho amalayini ayawela.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Isilinganiso sama-coefficient silungile kodwa i-constant term ayisesilinganisweni esinjalo, ngakho yilayini elihlukile elifanayo.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c3: a ngu-2 noma 0. Ukubukeka kwalo kufana nesibalo sokuqala, noma akwenzi ilayini.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo: (4, −2, −2), (−2, 1, 1), (6, −3, −3). Uma izinombolo ezintathu zesibalo sesibili ziyizinombolo ezintathu (2, −1, −1) zesibalo sokuqala eziphindaphindwe ngenombolo efanayo, izibalo ezimbili ziyilayini ofanayo. Uma ngisho nenombolo eyodwa ihamba kwalesi silinganiso, akuyona ilayini elifanayo.

y-m-25-05.title: Ingabe oneslope enkulu ushesha kakhulu?
y-m-25-05.topic: Ukufunda i-slope yegrafu: ukuqhathanisa amagrafu amabili anamayunithi ahlukene
y-m-25-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi i-slope kumele ifundwe ndawonye namayunithi ayo, bese uqhathanisa amagrafu amabili anamayunithi ahlukene ngokuwaguqulela abe amayunithi afanayo.
y-m-25-05.material: UDoyun noSeoa ngamunye uhambe wadweba amarekhodi awo njengamagrafu. Igrafu kaDoyun inesikhathi (imizuzu) ku-axis evundlile nebanga elihanjwe (m) ku-axis eqondile, futhi ilayini eqondile elidlula ku-origin (0, 0) naphoyinti (10, 700). Igrafu kaSeoa inesikhathi (amahora) ku-axis evundlile nebanga elihanjwe (km) ku-axis eqondile, futhi ilayini eqondile elidlula ku-origin naphoyinti (2, 10).
y-m-25-05.thinking.1: Ukuguqulela ezinhlotsheni ezifanayo zeyunithi ukuze uqhathanise
y-m-25-05.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-slope a kugrafu yomsebenzi olayini y=ax
y-m-25-05.s.s1.prompt: UDoyun uthe, 'I-slope yegrafu yami ingu-70 neka-Seoa ingu-5, ngakho ngishesha kakhulu!' Wawuhlulela kanjani lesi sitatimende?
y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kugrafu ngayinye, sho ukuthi i-axis eqondile ikhula kangakanani uma i-axis evundlile ikhula ngo-1, ndawonye neyunithi.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi amayunithi ama-slope amabili afana yini.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.a: Amayunithi amagrafu amabili ahlukile, ngakho awakwazi ukuqhathaniswa ngezinombolo kuphela
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde incazelo yoqonde kanye neyunithi yawo.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.b: Okukhulu kakhulu ukuthambeka, kushesha kakhulu, ngakho uDoyun, ongu-70 omkhulu kuno-5, ushesha kakhulu
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.b: Uqhathanise kuphela osayizi bezinombolo ngaphandle kokuhlola amayunithi.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.c: Okuncane ukuthambeka, kushesha ukufinyelela ibanga elifanayo, ngakho uSeoa ushesha kakhulu
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ubudlelwano phakathi kokuthambeka nejubane ngokuphambene.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuthambeka yinani i-eksisi eqondile elikhula ngalo lapho i-eksisi evundlile ikhula ngo-1. UDoyun uhamba u-70 m ngomzuzu futhi uSeoa uhamba u-5 km ngehora, ngakho uma amayunithi ehlukile, awakwazi ukuqhathaniswa ngezinombolo kuphela.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.prompt: Uma ushintsha ukuhamba kukaDoyun kube yimayunithi efanayo negrafu kaSeoa (amahora ku-eksisi evundlile, km ku-eksisi eqondile), uDoyun uhamba u-d km emahoreni angu-t. Faka amapheya angu-3 ahlukile (t, d) afanelana nalobu budlelwano. Kodwa, 0 < t ≤ 3.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.hint.0: Thola ibanga uDoyun alihamba emzuzwini o-1, bese uthola ibanga alihamba ehoreni elingu-1.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha ibanga owalitholile lisuke ku-m liye ku-km, lungisa izikhathi ezimbalwa, futhi ubale amabanga.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.fail.c1: U-t akakhulu kuno-0 futhi akadluli u-3.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Akuhambisani nokuhamba kukaDoyun. UDoyun uhamba u-700 m emizuzwini engu-10, futhi ihora elingu-1 lingu-60 imizuzu futhi u-1 km ungu-1000 m.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.explain: UDoyun uhamba u-700 m emizuzwini engu-10, okungukuthi, u-70 m emzuzwini o-1. Ehoreni elingu-1 (imizuzu engu-60), kungu-4200 m = 4.2 km, ngakho amaphoyinti anjengo-(1, 4.2), (2, 8.4), (0.5, 2.1) wonke ayahambisana.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Emshweni owodwa noma emibili, bhala ukuthi uthole kanjani u-(t, d).
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala ubhale emshweni ubudlelwano phakathi komzuzu o-1 nehora elingu-1.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bese ubhala ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-m no-km.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ungalandela ukuthi inani lokugcina livela kuphi?
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Ngu-700 m emizuzwini engu-10, ngakho ngu-70 m emzuzwini o-1. Ihora elingu-1 lingu-60 imizuzu, ngakho u-70×60=4200 m, futhi u-1000 m ungu-1 km, ngakho ngu-4.2 km.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.1: U-700 m ungu-0.7 km futhi imizuzu engu-10 ingu-1/6 wehora. Ehoreni elingu-1, uhamba u-0.7×6=4.2 km.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.2: U-700 m emizuzwini engu-10, ngakho ngejubane ngehora kungu-700*6=4200 m, okungukuthi, 4.2 km/h.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.prompt: Kusho ukuthi uDoyun uhamba u-4.2 km ngehora futhi uSeoa uhamba u-5 km ngehora. Ukuze leli qhathaniso libe nomqondo, yisiphi isimo esidingeka ngokuphelele?
y-m-25-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kunketho ngayinye, cabanga ukuthi leso simo asikho futhi ucabange ukuthi ungasasho inani elilodwa lika-'bangaki km ngehora.'
y-m-25-05.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenza linye ngalinye ukuthi inketho ngayinye iyilwazi oludingekayo ukuthola ijubane.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.a: Silinganise ibanga abantu ababili abalihambile ngesikhathi esifanayo
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi amabanga esikhathi esifanayo kumele aqhathaniswe. Akudingeki ukuqhathanisa amajubane.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.b: Abantu ababili bahambe emgwaqweni ofanayo ohlangothini olufanayo
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi kwakumele kube yimgwaqo ofanayo, kodwa umumo womgwaqo awunandaba ekuqhathaniseni amajubane.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.c: Ubone ukuthi kuphela kugrafu yomugqa oqondile uthambeka ulingana nejubane.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.d: Abantu ababili beqale endaweni efanayo ngesikhathi esifanayo
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi amaphoyinti okuqala kumele afane, kodwa ijubane alinakho ukuhlobana nendawo yokuqala.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.explain: Uma igrafu iyimugqa oqondile, kusho ukuthi ijubane alishintshi, ngakho ukuthambeka ngejubane. Isikhathi esifanayo, umgwaqo ofanayo, nendawo yokuqala efanayo akudingeki.
